en.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley's Anti-Monster Camp Quest Uncovers a Honey Heist
en.summary: The latest chapter in Disney Dreamlight Valley's Honeyglow Woods saga, 'The Anti-Monster Camp,' kicks off with an unexpected culinary challenge before delving into a mystery. Players must prepare a delightful picnic to soothe their Winnie the Pooh friends.
en.body:
The fog-laden Honeyglow Woods continues to be the focus of our adventures in **Disney Dreamlight Valley**, as Chapter 11, titled 'The Anti-Monster Camp,' officially begins. After the significant undertaking of repairing the Nectar Apiary's campsite in the previous quest, it's time to gather our friends and prepare for what comes next. Surprisingly, the initial step isn't battling shadowy creatures or navigating treacherous terrain, but rather something far more wholesome: cooking.

Our immediate objective is to whip up four **Toasted Picnic Sandwiches**. This culinary endeavor requires a specific set of ingredients gathered from around the valley. You'll need **Golden Honey**, **Parsnips**, **Tree Resin**, any **Dairy** product, and any **Spice**. Once these four hearty sandwiches are prepared, the next step is to share them. Head back to the campfire, present the sandwiches to **Winnie the Pooh**, and enjoy one yourself before embarking on the next phase of the quest.

## A Picnic and a Mystery

With satisfied stomachs, the group sets their sights on a picnic at the edge of the encroaching fog. To make this gathering truly welcoming, players must craft two essential decorative items: a **Welcoming Signpost** and a **Welcoming Picnic Blanket**. The materials needed are likely familiar to seasoned players who have spent ample time foraging and gathering resources. You’ll need five pieces of **Driftwood**, five **White & Pink Foxgloves**, three units of **Tree Resin**, five **Oak Leaves**, and five **Rose & Cream Foxgloves**. Additionally, five **White Thistles** are required for the picnic blanket. Many of these items can be gathered from the various biomes you've explored, making this a relatively straightforward crafting session for those who have been diligently collecting.

## Uncovering the Honey Thief

Beyond the sandwiches and picnic decor, 'The Anti-Monster Camp' quest introduces a gentle mystery that ties into the ongoing narrative of the Honeyglow Woods. The core objective, beyond setting up a pleasant picnic, is to discover who has been pilfering the precious honey. This element adds a layer of intrigue to the otherwise peaceful gameplay, encouraging players to engage with the characters and their surroundings more deeply. The quest culminates in uncovering the identity of the honey thief, bringing a satisfying resolution to this particular chapter of the Honeyglow Woods storyline. It’s a charming narrative beat that perfectly encapsulates the blend of familiar Disney characters and engaging gameplay loops that **Disney Dreamlight Valley** is known for.

## What's Next

With the Anti-Monster Camp established and the honey mystery solved, players can look forward to further developments in the Honeyglow Woods. Future quests will likely continue to explore the nature of the fog and the shadowy figures within, potentially introducing new characters or expanding on existing storylines. The **Lovely Monsters Star Path** is also a current event offering themed rewards, so players have plenty to keep them engaged in the valley.

content_raw: After repairing the Nectar Apiary’s campsite, it’s time to dive deeper into Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Honeyglow Woods questline as we begin Chapter 11: The Anti-Monster Camp. While the past few missions have talked about monsters, scary shadows, and fog, the beginning of this quest has us cooking some sandwiches. Table of contents How to complete Chapter 11: The Anti-Monster Camp in Disney Dreamlight Valley Cook Toasted Picnic Sandwiches Craft a Welcoming Signpost and Welcoming Picnic Blanket How to complete Chapter 11: The Anti-Monster Camp in Disney Dreamlight Valley After completing Chapter 10: Most Grand Adventure and repairing the campsite, you and the Honeyglow Woods trio will decide what to do next. At first, the main plan of action is to make some sandwiches before proceeding. Cook Toasted Picnic Sandwiches Our first objective is to cook four Toasted Picnic Sandwiches for ourselves, Eeyore, Piglet, and Winnie the Pooh. You’ll need the following ingredients to make them: Golden Honey Parsnips Tree Resin Any Dairy Any Spice Screenshot by Destructoid After making all four meals, head back to the campfire and give Pooh Bear the sandwiches before eating one yourself. You’re now determined to make a picnic at the edge of the fog. Craft a Welcoming Signpost and Welcoming Picnic Blanket After eating your food with the trio, you’ll need the following materials to craft a Welcoming Signpost and Welcoming Picnic Blanket: Driftwood (5) White & Pink Foxglove (5) Tree Resin (3) Golden Honey Oak Leaves (5) Welcoming Honey Treat Rose & Cream Foxglove (5) White Thistle (5) By now, you’ll likely have many of these materials from the time you’ve spent hunting other resources during previous quests. After collecting each item, head to any crafting station and create the Welcoming Signpost and Welcoming Picnic Blanket before returning to Piglet. Screenshot by Destructoid Once the two of you head towards the edge of the fog and place down both furniture items, head to the campsite and talk to Eeyore. Following a brief conversation, you’ll hear a weird noise from the picnic area that, upon closer inspection, reveals that the honey has already been eaten. Your new task is to find out who ate it. After talking to Piglet, Eeyore, and Pooh Bear, Pooh will admit that he saw what happened. Although he wanted to eat the honey himself, someone—or something—got to it before him.
